items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Earl Hines came there. ... I never could quite figure -- I mean when I've heard Casino, he sounds as though he was doing an imitation of Earl.

ctx.x: Yeah, Earl Hines came there. Quite a few of the fellows came there.
Well, what -- there was one thing I was going to ask you was -- we skipped over that, but Casino Simpson was in that --

items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Cliff got this group and this piano player went... to Europe... we used to call him the professor

ctx.x: They were all much younger, couple guys a little bit, but they were -- we had a nice experience because we all worked around together. Then Cliff got this group and this piano player went (unintelligible) to Europe, and -- oh, he came back -- very good piano player, read everything, all kind of Bach, Beethoven, play jazz too. And I was trying to call his name. He was Earl something, and we used to call him the professor because
he wore his hair long, a very light fellow, wore his hair long, we called him the professor. Said, Professor, what are you going to play? Cliff was concerned, very concerned because --
Oh, this piano player played with (unintelligible)?
